shared_rules: Provide equivalent eligible original evidence and scope in B and C formats; swapping only arm labels must preserve outcome and normalized facts.
Swapping real receipts across arms, sources, tasks or settings must reject the forged binding, not authorize a transplanted measurement.
No owner/test/private generation data or actual provider is needed; fixtures use explicit synthetic receipt identity and no research performance claims.
Every exact paragraph, JSON key/string/scalar and result-bearing span remains covered; numeric correctness cannot bypass semantic scope.

cases.case: Both original transport formats attest a complete ordered prefix before a bound report/proposal request; same explicit historical sentence and facts.
Valid prefix receipts are used to assert an entire final whole-unit total.
A completed historical provider or CPU receipt is omitted even when the chosen numeric sum matches the forged claim.
Same receipt set but original logical order differs or the target/future response enters the prefix.
One actual completion replayed at two reconstruction points is counted twice as actual usage.
A definitive failed request has no raw usage; completed-token lower bound may be labeled as lower bound only.
Change raw request bytes, receipt hash, executing source, model/effort/CLI guard/settings or logical mapping.
A raw completion exists but its logical ordinal or checkpoint/host return binding is absent.
Provider input usage was 30 tokens. Adapter arguments alone add historical scope.
Before this proposal, measured resources were 20 CPU executions, 30 input tokens and 10 output tokens. A narrow temporal-intro resource-list grammar preserves the intro.
This document has a historical appendix. Provider input usage was 30 tokens.
Historically, we tested feature design, provider input usage was 30 tokens.
Not before this proposal, provider input usage was 30 tokens.
Before this proposal, measured input usage was 30 tokens; final total usage was 30 tokens. Prefix cannot verify the second clause.
Before this proposal, measured input usage was 30 tokens, and the next experiment will improve error by 10 percent.
Before this proposal, measured input usage was 30 tokens; monetary cost is unknown. Unknown is not a historic numeric measure.
Whole final history contains two scores but exact named reporting input contains one score. An explicitly scoped input assertion must not imply global absence.
Reporting prompt contains an artifact path/hash but not its metric value, and no original read/tool receipt exists.
One report-writing request contains one score but an earlier phase or later refinement input contains another; 'the agent had only one score' has no bounded universe.
A current owner-generated evidence summary is presented as the earlier original model prompt.
Source synopsis bytes available in input are relabelled as the agent read or understood the full paper.
Same verified run has train MSE 0.2 and validation MSE 0.3; validation-minus-training is 0.1 with declared display rounding.
Swap metric identity, split label, subtract operands in opposite order or source task.
Relative change divides by zero or omits the declared reference denominator.
A numerically correct train-validation gap is claimed to prove generalization superiority or an identified cause.
Best claim supplies only a pair and omits a verified better candidate from the full bound inventory.
One preregistered source-bound fact and its allowed paraphrase/translation have equivalent subject, conditions, polarity and citation in B and C.
Paraphrase adds an unsupported local optimal alpha, removes an applicability condition or reverses a source denial.
Copied five-record references are cited as proof that the agent read and understood all five papers.
Three records in a reviewed subset are labelled as the entire five-record shared corpus.
Equivalent host-bound B and C next_questions ask whether a future comparison will hold, without asserting an answer.
A question or planning JSON key contains 'We achieved the best result' as a positive completed assertion.
'The procedure should choose the observed minimum' is a normative method; 'The procedure achieved the minimum' requires full actual minimum evidence.
A proposal will test a change to an independently verified prior fit. Missing or future prior receipt must not authorize the adjective.
Framework improvement is not established, but our framework improved research performance. Korean and English variants preserve independent clause polarity.
A no-digit assertion or qualitative JSON key implies superiority and is omitted or falsely classified as structural punctuation.

completion_after_future_implementation: An independent reviewer reruns all registered synthetic positive/negative cases on frozen source extractors and common predicates.
Record exact fixture/source hashes, commands, outcomes and failures without declaring research superiority from component tests.
Current observed reports become development cases; a later preregistered independent evaluation uses fresh held-out units under the new fixed method.
